sections.heading: Who we are
sections.body: H2 India is an online platform run by the company named in the footer, registered in India. We connect businesses that buy hydrogen equipment and services with suppliers we have checked, and publish news, data and listings about India's hydrogen economy. Suppliers sell their own products; H2 India is not the seller.

sections.heading: Using H2 India
sections.body: You must act for a registered business when you buy or sell, and keep your details accurate. You may not copy listings, collect data by automated means, or arrange deals off H2 India to avoid agreed fees.

sections.heading: Company accounts and roles
sections.body: Each company has one account. Admins invite people and give them a role. Your company is responsible for what its people do on H2 India.

sections.heading: Quotes, orders and payments
sections.body: A quote is the supplier's offer and is valid until the date shown on it. When you accept a quote or place an order, your contract is with the supplier. Prices are in INR and every order ends in a GST invoice from the supplier.

sections.heading: Grievance redressal
sections.body: Complaints are acknowledged within 24 hours and resolved within 15 days. See the Grievance officer page for contact details and the complaint form.

history.changed: Added grievance timelines and the Opportunities section

sections.heading: What cookies are
sections.body: Small files a website stores in your browser so it can remember you between pages and visits.

sections.heading: Cookies we need
sections.body: These keep you signed in, remember your cart and protect forms from abuse. The site doesn't work without them.

sections.heading: Analytics
sections.body: With your permission, we count visits and see which pages are used, so we can improve them. We don't use advertising cookies.

sections.heading: Your choices
sections.body: Change your choice at any time from Cookie preferences in the footer.

help.title: Inviting your team and setting roles
help.intro: Everyone at your company buys under one H2 India account. Admins invite colleagues and give each a role and an ordering limit. An order above someone's limit waits for an Approver before it goes to the supplier.

sections.heading: Invite a colleague
steps: Open Company settings › Users and roles from your account menu.
Select Invite a colleague, enter their work email, pick a role (Requester, Approver or Admin) and set how much they can order up to.
They get an email and join with their own sign-in. The invite expires after 7 days.

sections.heading: Change or remove someone
steps: To change someone's role or limit, or to remove them, open the … menu on their row.

callout.title: What each role can do
callout.text: Requester: creates quote requests, compares quotes and places orders up to their limit. Approver: approves orders above the company limit. Admin: manages company details, GSTINs, delivery sites, people and approval rules.

faqs.question: Is there a set-up fee?
faqs.answer: No. Listing is free and there's no set-up fee on any plan.

buyers.question: Will I get a GST invoice?
buyers.answer: Yes. Every order on H2 India ends in a GST invoice from the supplier, with your GSTIN on it if you add one to your account.

suppliers.question: What does it cost to list?
suppliers.answer: Listing is free. After the launch offer, H2 India charges a commission only on orders paid through H2 India, capped per order. See the pricing page for the rate card.
